items.title: Michelin Says India Tyre Manufacturing Is About Market Access, Not Lower Costs
items.summary: Michelin’s decision to manufacture passenger car tyres in India is aimed at moving closer to a growing premium-vehicle market and adapting its products to local conditions, rather than securing an immediate cost advantage, a senior company executive said. “The reason for us to produce it is not a cost reason,” Vitor Silva, president of Michelin’s Africa, India and Middle East region, said during a media interaction.
